hadith_review_evidence.name: hadith_review_evidence
hadith_review_evidence.value: "hadith_passages"."review_state" != 'reviewed' OR ("hadith_passages"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "hadith_passages"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL)

idea_suggestion_results.name: idea_suggestion_results
idea_suggestion_results.value: CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("idea_suggestion_sets"."suggestions") = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length("idea_suggestion_sets"."suggestions") = 3 ELSE false END

rewrite_alternatives.name: rewrite_alternatives
rewrite_alternatives.value: CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("script_rewrite_suggestions"."alternatives") = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length("script_rewrite_suggestions"."alternatives") = 3 ELSE false END

passage_reference.name: passage_reference
passage_reference.value: "source_passages"."chapter" BETWEEN 1 AND 114 AND "source_passages"."verse" BETWEEN 1 AND 286 AND "source_passages"."reference" = "source_passages"."chapter"::text || ':' || "source_passages"."verse"::text
